# Origin Construction — Hyderabad, Telangana

> Origin Construction is a Hyderabad-based design-and-build construction company headquartered in Upperpally, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It offers turnkey house construction, villa and apartment construction, commercial construction, interior design and home renovation (including MEP) across Hyderabad, Secunderabad and Telangana.

## Key facts
- Name: Origin Construction
- Website: https://originconstruction.in/
- Address: Villa No 107, Parmareddy Hills, Upperpally, Hyderabad 500048, Telangana, India
- Phone: +91 9391 743 896
- Email: originconstruction@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST
- Track record: 120+ completed projects, 15+ ongoing projects, 99% client satisfaction, 12+ awards
- Leadership: Mohammed Israr Uddin (CEO & Founder); Mohammed Ahsan Uddin Abbas (Architect, Researcher)

## Services
- Construction: independent houses, duplex villas, G+ apartments and commercial buildings in Hyderabad; RCC framed structures, approval-ready drawings (GHMC / HMDA / TG-bPASS), itemised BOQ and milestone-based payments.
- Interior Designing: home and office interiors in Hyderabad — modular kitchens, wardrobes, false ceilings, lighting, wall finishes, with 3D designs before execution.
- Renovations: home renovation and remodelling in Hyderabad — bathroom and kitchen renovation, waterproofing, structural repairs, electrical and plumbing (MEP) upgrades.

## Process
1. Conceptual Design — site visit, requirement brief, budget planning, Vastu-friendly concept layouts and 3D renderings.
2. Schematic & Approvals — floor plans, elevations, structural design and approval-ready drawings for GHMC, HMDA or Telangana municipal norms.
3. Development & Construction — working drawings, BOQ, execution with stage-wise quality checks and on-time handover.

## Service areas
Hyderabad: Upperpally, Attapur, Rajendranagar, Mehdipatnam, Tolichowki, Manikonda, Narsingi, Kokapet, Puppalaguda, Bandlaguda Jagir, Gachibowli, Financial District, HITEC City, Madhapur, Kondapur, Jubilee Hills, Banjara Hills, Masab Tank, Secunderabad, Begumpet, Kukatpally, Miyapur, Bachupally, Kompally, Uppal, LB Nagar, Shamshabad, Adibatla, Tellapur, Shankarpally.
Telangana districts: Ranga Reddy, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Sangareddy, Vikarabad, Mahabubnagar, Warangal, Karimnagar, Nizamabad.
